## Contract and decision impact

- [ ] No locked contract, schema, state-machine, authority, or ADR impact
- [ ] Contract/schema changes are documented, versioned, migrated, and compatibility-tested
- [ ] A superseding ADR and gate review are linked where required

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, lint, typecheck, unit, and contract checks pass
- [ ] Failure paths, retries/replay, authorization, and unsafe transitions are tested as applicable
- [ ] Deterministic evidence/fixture artifacts and run IDs are linked
- [ ] User-facing changes include target-resolution screenshots/video and accessibility checks

## Safety, privacy, and compliance

- [ ] No secrets, private research, proprietary media/telemetry, personal data, or internal URLs
- [ ] Assets and dependencies have compatible licenses and recorded provenance
- [ ] Submitted runtime remains Vertex AI/Gemini plus Google ADK only
- [ ] Grafana MCP remains private, authenticated, read-only, and least privilege
- [ ] Actions remain typed, human-approved, idempotent, and simulator-only
- [ ] Untrusted content cannot become instructions or executable commands

Describe rollout, migration/rollback constraints, and expected failure behavior.
